bugs_found: fx_convert multiplies Decimal by float(rate), causing TypeError or precision loss instead of Decimal-safe conversion
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failure crediting account_to can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing float/type edge cases and arithmetic failures
apply_fee can return negative net amount when fee_min, fee_max, or fee_pct allow fee > amount
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year with int(), changing behavior without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months with int(), changing repayment schedule without validation
principal in compound_interest is not validated non-negative, allowing nonsensical negative investments
